title.hr: Tri faze: raspodjela reflektora na agregatu
title.en: Three phases: spreading the lamps on a generator

concept.hr: Svaka faza ima svoju granicu; ono što se ne poništi vraća se nulvodičem
concept.en: Each phase has its own limit; what does not cancel returns on the neutral

summary.hr: Uključi reflektore u tri faze agregata: struja svake faze i nulvodiča, jedna faza izbaci dok druge stoje, pa ponovo raspodijeli.
summary.en: Plug lamps into a generator's three phases: each phase's current and the neutral's, one phase trips while two idle, then rebalance.
